$comment: Figma layer path (as in spec.json) -> element inside the entry's target (.ds-marker) and how to read it. skip: spec keys not compared for this layer.

content.$why: Separator: the text hugs its width, which follows glyph rasterisation; Default and Border: the row less the icon.

Rule/VECTOR.$why: The rules are ::before and ::after, which the check cannot select; the pixels cover them.

Border.$why: The bottom rule is an inset shadow on the marker; the pixels cover it.
